title: Maria's Shopping Trip
text:
Maria goes to the market on Sunday. She has a shopping list. The list has bread, milk, eggs and apples. She buys the bread first.

Then she goes to the fruit stand. She wants apples, but there are no green apples. She buys red apples instead. At home, she puts everything in the fridge.

questions.text: What is on Maria's shopping list?
What does Maria buy at the fruit stand?
Why does Maria buy red apples?
options: She forgot her list at home
There were no green apples at the stand

questions.text: Where does Maria probably put the food when she gets home?

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy food and other goods
a set of written words or items to remember
a cold box in a kitchen where food is kept fresh
as a replacement for something else

paragraph_translations: María va al mercado el domingo. Tiene una lista de compras. La lista tiene pan, leche, huevos y manzanas. Ella compra el pan primero.
Luego va al puesto de frutas. Quiere manzanas, pero no hay manzanas verdes. Ella compra manzanas rojas en su lugar. En casa, pone todo en la nevera.
